papers.title: Quantum speedup of Monte Carlo methods
findings: Original unitary preparation/inverse requirements, p7; AE error bound p8 Theorem2; controlled bounded-value rotation pp8-9 Algorithm1 and Theorem3.
Known relative-sensitive AE and elementary ratio perturbation suffice for the conditional Born-readout upper bound.
limitations: Only listed pages scope-read; no independent reconstruction of all proofs, full variance algorithm, partition-function results or lower bounds.

papers.title: Quantum rejection sampling
findings: The original resampling model transforms known amplitudes with fixed unknown attached states, using unitary oracle and its adjoint.
Classical acceptance conditioning predates the project. The paper gives state-generation query results in its own formal model.
limitations: Only listed pages scope-read; its tight lower bound and appendices were not independently proved and are not transferred to the current learned-score readout.
